integrity: The infinite statement is proved analytically from the complete-multipartite neighborhood rule.
The literature comparison distinguishes prior special cases and general existence bounds from the new exact classification.
scientific_limitations: The proof is specific to complete multipartite graphs and does not cover arbitrary diameter-two graphs or cross-edge deletions.
Stars, complete graphs, and the published \(K_{2,m}\) example are prior-covered boundary cases; the contribution is the arbitrary-part classification and the remaining exact cases.
Finite exhaustive verification through order eight is corroborative and is not used as an infinite-family proof.
title: Dual-server total domination and total dual-server domination of complete multipartite graphs
